Any verifier that relies on the stored alg label, or supports only ES256, will either fail or treat an unapproved key type as compliant.",
    "fix": "Remove alg -257 from registerIdentityKey (keep ES256 only), or explicitly approve RS256 in the algorithm policy. In either case, read the real algorithm with response.getPublicKeyAlgorithm(), convert the SPKI from getPublicKey() into a real JWK instead of hardcoding EC/ES256, and reject at registration any algorithm the policy does not allow.",
    "severity": "medium",
    "confidence": 0.4,
    "_diff_anchor": "in_diff"
  }
]
